# Event catalogue

<!-- GENERATED by `npm run docs:events` from src/lib/events/catalogue.ts and the registered consumers. Do not edit by hand: catalogueDoc.test.ts fails when this file drifts from the code. -->

175 event types, 185 contracts (a type gains a version when its contract changes; producers emit the current one, consumers and replay still accept the older ones).
Current versions by sensitivity: SENSITIVE 25, INTERNAL 102, LOW 48.

Every event is also delivered to `observability-projection` and `workflow-engine` (they handle `*`; the workflow engine starts only the workflows whose active definitions trigger on that type and version), so the Consumers column lists the other consumers.

Emitted from: the functions that pass the type to an emit call, found by the static analysis behind emitCoverage.test.ts, plus the registered emitting helpers (EMITTING_HELPERS).

Payload fields: `?` optional, `∅` nullable. Payloads carry identifiers and closed codes only; contracts are `.strict()`, so an unknown key is rejected on emit and on replay.
